name: Java
summary: Java the way university CS courses and AP Computer Science teach it: types, the compiler, methods, collections and objects, with problem sets graded by real tests.

levels.name: Basics: types, input, strings, decisions, loops, collections, methods, exceptions, objects
Objects in depth: interfaces, inheritance, generics, testing with JUnit
Algorithms and data structures (MIT 6.006 / Princeton style, in Java)
Mastering Java: the standard library, streams, debugging, performance
Professional craft: builds, design patterns, code review, security
Capstone: a real project, then a defense

certs: AP Computer Science A covers Level 1-2
